Blackburn, meanwhile, have slipped to 14th after consecutive defeats and will be eager to get back on track in front of their home supporters.

 Blackburn vs. West Ham - Head-to-head record
 The sides have met only four times. Their most recent encounter came in the 2022 League Cup, when Blackburn won 3-2 away on penalties after a 2-2 draw in normal time.
 West Ham’s most recent victory over Blackburn was a 5-1 FA Cup win in 2016, while their two Premier League meetings in 2010 and 2011 both ended in 1-1 draws.
 The recent record therefore offers little to separate the teams , although West Ham will hope their stronger league position and unbeaten away run can give them the edge this time.

 Blackburn - Seeking a return to form
 Let’s take a closer look at Blackburn’s current situation. We will analyse the team’s recent form and their latest results, before considering how they might approach this match.
 Recent form
 Blackburn sit 14th in the Championship after a mixed start to the campaign . Tony Mowbray’s side have lost three of their last four league matches, including consecutive defeats against Swansea City and Stoke City.
 The 4-0 loss away to Swansea was followed by a 2-1 home defeat to Stoke on Tuesday, ending a run of three successive Championship wins at Ewood Park. Blackburn are five points below the playoff places and will be keen to avoid another setback.
 Their defensive record remains a concern, but the Rovers have shown they can be dangerous going forward. A. Guðjohnsen has been a particularly important attacking presence, scoring nine goals in 13 appearances.
 Blackburn could also have a selection issue at right-back, with Ryan Alebiosu an injury doubt. Gady Beyuku may be handed a start, while Moussa Baradji is pushing for a place in midfield. Yuki Ohashi is another option, but Mowbray may otherwise keep faith with much of the side that started against Stoke.

 West Ham - Struggling for recent results
 Let’s take a closer look at West Ham’s situation. We will analyse the team’s current form, their recent results, and standout players for this match.
 Recent form
 West Ham are eighth in the Championship and remain firmly in contention for promotion . They have scored at least six more goals than any other side in the division, underlining their attacking potential, although recent defensive performances have been less convincing.
 The Hammers have gone three league matches without a win, but Wednesday’s 3-3 draw away to Cardiff offered encouragement. They recovered from three goals down to claim a point in Scott Parker’s first match in charge, having previously lost 3-1 to West Brom and 3-2 to Southampton.
 Their away record is a major positive. West Ham are unbeaten in seven Championship trips this season, recording three wins and four draws. They will be looking to maintain that run at Ewood Park.
 J. Bowen has been one of their leading performers, contributing seven goals and five assists. Parker could make changes after the Cardiff comeback, with Ezra Mayers, Mohamadou Kante and Joel Piroe all pushing for starting places. Tomas Soucek is another option, although the new manager may prefer to avoid making too many alterations.

 Predictions for Blackburn vs. West Ham - Hammers to win
 West Ham arrive with a formidable unbeaten away record, having scored an impressive 18 goals in seven games on the road. This attacking strength suggests a decisive outcome with over 2.5 goals is likely.
 Blackburn, on the other hand, have been inconsistent and come into this fixture after two straight defeats. Their defence has looked vulnerable, and against a potent Hammers attack, they could find themselves trailing at half-time.
 Given West Ham’s strong away form and Blackburn’s recent struggles, the visitors are clear favourites. Therefore, our main prediction is for West Ham to secure the victory in this Championship encounter.
